propositions: Runner return values cannot currently distinguish clean execution from failed/cancelled/skipped/budget-shed/resumed outcomes, causing empty successful checkpoints in plan-review and work erasure in code-review.

A new independent discovery kernel submodule must define immutable typed plan inputs (DiscoveryStagePlan/DiscoveryUnitPlan) and six outcome kinds (success/resumed/skipped/shed/failed/cancelled) without modifying or importing existing verify/decide/coach symbols.

The executor must perform dependency-aware scheduling, deterministic ascending-order budget shedding with cascade to dependent units, usage accumulation, and cancellation observation such that in-flight non-interruptible calls commit their true outcome while not-yet-dispatched work is marked cancelled.

The versioned digest-complete checkpoint envelope must round-trip only success and content-identical resumed units; failed/cancelled/skipped/shed/corrupt/legacy envelopes remain missing and reuse is blocked.

Stored trace must contain normalized outcome metadata and lineage (ids, reasons, usage) excluding raw prompts, ticket bodies, provider responses, and secrets, with no change to public review-status schemas.

Fault-injection tests must prove that after a local failure, earlier successes are retained, later independent units execute, dependent units are marked skipped with dependency reason, and a clean rerun succeeds without duplicating state.
